blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — The local business sector is sounding the alarm over recurring power outages and spiking electricity rates across the Visayas Grid, warning that the unstable power supply threatens local economic growth, jobs, and enterprise survival. In a press statement issued Tuesday, the Filipino-Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Iloilo, Inc. (FCCCI) voiced deep concern over repeated yellow and red alerts that triggered Manual Load Dropping (MLD) and rotational blackouts throughout Iloilo City and nearby areas. The chamber noted that local businesses face a double burden: escalating electricity rates alongside the steep indirect costs of power interruptions. Commercial electricity rates in […]...
